runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle, blind to diff/plan/src/tests)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json -> id 8020 "Abyssal Mask" -> passives[0] ("Unmake", unique) -> branches[0]
sources_quoted.text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources_quoted.reading: Amplifier magnitude = +12%; the amplified quantity is explicitly gated to MAGIC damage ('12% increased magic damage'), not to all damage types. 'from all sources' qualifies WHO may deal it, not WHICH damage types are amplified.

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json -> id 4005 "Imperial Mandate" -> passives[1] ("Command", unique) -> branches[0]
sources_quoted.text: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
sources_quoted.reading: Amplifier magnitude = +7%; the amplified quantity is UNgated by damage type ('the damage they take'), so it applies to physical, magic and true alike.
The cached atomization independently classifies Unmake's 12% under the damage.magic family (700 = aura radius, 12 = percent), corroborating the magic-only gate.
Second, independently-generated atom file agrees: Unmake belongs to the magic-damage family.

sources_quoted.text: post = raw · m(R) ... m(R) = 1/(1 + R/100); mitigation ... is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance (§1.2.1)
sources_quoted.reading: Because mitigation is linear in raw damage, a constant damage-taken amplifier commutes with mitigation, so applying it as a scalar multiplier on the source total is exact. math-foundations.md states no rule that would let a magic-only amplifier touch non-magic damage, and no additive-stacking rule for separate amplifiers.

observed_ratio.note: 758.0 / 676.8 = 1.11998, i.e. exactly Abyssal Mask Unmake's 1.12 factor within the golden leaves' 1-decimal rounding. 676.8 * 1.12 = 758.016 -> 758.0. The single factor separating the two values IS Unmake's +12% magic amplifier.

amplifier_composition_model.rule: Separate damage-taken amplifiers are independent multipliers on the mitigated total: total = base * (1 + a_1) * (1 + a_2) * ...

check_against_alternatives.multiplicative_both: base * 1.07 * 1.12 = base * 1.1984  -> reproduces the OLD value exactly (632.5 * 1.1984 = 757.99 -> 758.0)
check_against_alternatives.additive_both: base * (1 + 0.07 + 0.12) = base * 1.19 -> 632.5 * 1.19 = 752.7  (matches NEITHER value; the engine is not additive)
check_against_alternatives.strongest_wins: base * 1.12 = 708.4 (matches NEITHER value; note it would have KEPT the 12%, so the change is not an anti-stacking rule)

two_arithmetically_consistent_decomposit.label: A - Vulnerable applies to this source, Unmake was wrongly applied
B - Vulnerable never triggers in this scenario (no immobilize), Unmake was wrongly applied

independent_computation.why_both_decompositions_give_the_same_ve: Under either decomposition the entire delta is the removal of exactly one factor, 1.12, which is Abyssal Mask Unmake's magic-damage amplifier. Imperial Mandate's 1.07 behaves identically in old and new, so the change is specific to Unmake and is not a team-side/aura-presence change (that would have moved Mandate's factor too, since both items sit on the same roster side in this scenario).
independent_computation.wiki_derived_correct_value: Unmake amplifies MAGIC damage only. A selective removal of the 1.12 factor from one source of one defender's breakdown, while the same fight's other amplifier (Mandate's type-agnostic 1.07) is untouched, is the exact signature of gating Unmake by damage type. sources[3] is therefore a non-magic (physical or true) damage row, for which the cached wiki text grants NO Abyssal amplification. Correct total = pre-amp total x (Vulnerable factor only) = 676.8.
independent_computation.arithmetic_of_the_correct_value: 632.5 (mitigated, pre-amplifier) x 1.07 (Imperial Mandate 'Vulnerable', all damage types) x 1.00 (Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' does NOT apply: source is not magic damage) = 676.775 -> 676.8

residual_uncertainty.statement: The scenario definition (which champion/ability occupies sources[3] and its damage type) lives in scripts//tests/, which this runbook forbids reading, so the damage type of sources[3] was inferred, not observed.
why_the_inference_is_sound: The removed factor is exactly 1.12, uniquely identifying Abyssal Mask Unmake among the two amplifiers named in the scenario id.
Imperial Mandate's type-agnostic amplifier is unchanged across old/new, ruling out an aura-presence / wrong-team / roster-side change (which would have hit both items equally).
An anti-stacking ('strongest wins') change would have retained 1.12 and dropped 1.07, giving 708.4 - not observed.
An additive-stacking change would have given 752.7 - not observed.

The scenario id foregrounds 'abyssal_curse', so a change that disabled the curse outright would void the scenario's purpose; a per-damage-type gate keeps the curse live on the magic rows and removes it only where the wiki text never granted it.
residual_uncertainty.falsifier: If sources[3] is a MAGIC damage row, the old value 758.0 would be correct and this verdict flips. Nothing in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md supports that reading, and no other single mechanic in the two items produces a bare 1.12 factor.
